Understood — I can do this, but deletion is destructive so I need a quick confirmation of exactly how you want me to proceed.

Planned search (cutoff = older than one year from today):
- Gmail search query: from:billing@acme-cloud.example before:2025/09/04
(That will match messages dated earlier than 2025‑09‑04.)

Please confirm:
1) Action to take:
   - Permanently delete (irreversible) OR
   - Move to Trash only (recoverable until emptied) OR
   - Archive or apply label "Billing - Old" (non-destructive backup)
2) Do you want a preview first? I can run the search and report how many messages match and show up to 10 sample subjects/senders before I delete.
3) Any other constraints (include threads where billing@... is CCed? include Spam/Trash?) — otherwise I’ll use the query above.

Reply with your choice (for example: “Preview first” or “Yes — move to Trash and proceed”) and I’ll run the requested step.
